```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(readxl)
library(metafor)
library(meta)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
dat <- read_excel("data/Study_data.xlsx")
```


## Prenatal exposure analyses


```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
##pm2.5~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#height-smd
data1 <- filter(dat,exposure_window=='pre',exposure=='pm25',outcome=='height')
data2 <- filter(dat,exposure_window=='pre',exposure=='pm25',outcome=='height_z')
data<-rbind(data1,data2)
data$se<-(data$upper_smd-data$lower_smd)/1.96/2
res <- rma(yi = data$effect_smd, sei=data$se, method = "REML")
summary(res)

##weight
data <- filter(dat,exposure_window=='pre',exposure=='pm25',outcome=='weight')
data$se<-(data$upper-data$lower)/1.96/2
res <- rma(yi = data$effect, sei=data$se, method = "REML")
summary(res)

#weight-z
data <- filter(dat,exposure_window=='pre',exposure=='pm25',outcome=='weight_z')
data$se<-(data$upper-data$lower)/1.96/2
res <- rma(yi = data$effect, sei=data$se, method = "REML")
summary(res)
#Funnel
funnel(res, xlab = "Effect Size", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "PM2.5 and weight-z")
#egger
egger_test <- regtest(data$effect, data$se, model = "rma")
print(egger_test)  

tf_result <- trimfill(res)
summary(tf_result) 
funnel(tf_result,  xlab = "Effect Size", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "PM2.5 and weight-z TF")  

#weight-smd
data1 <- filter(dat,exposure_window=='pre',exposure=='pm25',outcome=='weight')
data2 <- filter(dat,exposure_window=='pre',exposure=='pm25',outcome=='weight_z')
data<-rbind(data1,data2)
data$se<-(data$upper_smd-data$lower_smd)/1.96/2
res <- rma(yi = data$effect_smd, sei=data$se, method = "REML")
summary(res)
#Funnel
funnel(data$effect_smd, data$se, xlab = "Effect Size", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "PM2.5 and weight SMD")
#egger
egger_test <- regtest(data$effect_smd, data$se, model = "rma")
print(egger_test)  

tf_result <- trimfill(res)
summary(tf_result) 
funnel(tf_result,  xlab = "Effect Size", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "PM2.5 and weight SMD TF")  

#BMI

tf_result <- trimfill(res)

funnel(tf_result,xlab = "Effect Size", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "PM2.5 and bmi TF")
```

## Prenatal exposure and owob


```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#pm2.5~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
data <- filter(dat,exposure_window=='pre',exposure=='pm25',outcome=='owob')
log_or=log(data$effect)
log_se<-(log(data$upper)-log(data$lower))/1.96/2
res <- rma(yi = log_or, sei=log_se, method = "REML")

res$I2
paste0(round(exp(res$beta),digits=3),'(',round(exp(res$ci.lb),digits=3),',',round(exp(res$ci.ub),digits=3),')')
res$pval



#Funnel
funnel(res, xlab = "Log(RR)", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "PM2.5 and OWOB")
#egger
egger_test <- regtest(res, model = "rma")
print(egger_test)  

tf_result <- trimfill(res)
summary(tf_result) 
paste0(round(exp(tf_result$beta),digits=3),'(',round(exp(tf_result$ci.lb),digits=3),',',round(exp(tf_result$ci.ub),digits=3),')')
funnel(tf_result,xlab = "Log(RR)", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "PM2.5 and OWOB TF")  

#meta regression
res <- rma(
  yi =  log_or, sei=log_se, method = "REML",
  mods = ~ data$country
)
summary(res)
paste0(round(exp(res$beta),digits=3),'(',round(exp(res$ci.lb),digits=3),',',round(exp(res$ci.ub),digits=3),')')

res <- rma(
  yi =  log_or, sei=log_se, method = "REML",
  mods = ~ data$year
)
summary(res)
paste0(round(exp(res$beta),digits=3),'(',round(exp(res$ci.lb),digits=3),',',round(exp(res$ci.ub),digits=3),')')


res <- rma(
  yi =  log_or, sei=log_se, method = "REML",
  mods = ~ data$nos
)
summary(res)
paste0(round(exp(res$beta),digits=3),'(',round(exp(res$ci.lb),digits=3),',',round(exp(res$ci.ub),digits=3),')')


#no2
data <- filter(dat,exposure_window=='pre',exposure=='no2',outcome=='owob')
log_or=log(data$effect)
log_se<-(log(data$upper)-log(data$lower))/1.96/2
res <- rma(yi = log_or, sei=log_se, method = "REML")

res$I2
paste0(round(exp(res$beta),digits=3),'(',round(exp(res$ci.lb),digits=3),',',round(exp(res$ci.ub),digits=3),')')
res$pval




#Funnel
funnel(res, xlab = "Log(RR)", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "no2 and OWOB")
#egger
egger_test <- regtest(res, model = "rma")
print(egger_test)  

tf_result <- trimfill(res)
summary(tf_result) 
paste0(round(exp(tf_result$beta),digits=3),'(',round(exp(tf_result$ci.lb),digits=3),',',round(exp(tf_result$ci.ub),digits=3),')')
funnel(tf_result,xlab = "Log(RR)", ylab = "Standard Error",main = "no2 and OWOB TF")  

#meta regression
res <- rma(
  yi =  log_or, sei=log_se, method = "REML",
  mods = ~ data$country
)
summary(res)
paste0(round(exp(res$beta),digits=3),'(',round(exp(res$ci.lb),digits=3),',',round(exp(res$ci.ub),digits=3),')')

res <- rma(
  yi =  log_or, sei=log_se, method = "REML",
  mods = ~ data$year
)
summary(res)
paste0(round(exp(res$beta),digits=3),'(',round(exp(res$ci.lb),digits=3),',',round(exp(res$ci.ub),digits=3),')')


res <- rma(
  yi =  log_or, sei=log_se, method = "REML",
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  61,22,37,9171

  rater1 = c(6,6,6,7,7,8,7,8,8,8,5,7,6,8,6,6,7,7,
             6,6,7,5,7,7,7,7,7,6,8,6,8,7,7,8,7,8,8,6,7,8,
             8, 7,7,7,6,7,5,7,7,7,7,8,7,8,7,7,7
  ),
  rater2 = c(6,6,6,7,7,7,6,7,6,7,5,7,6,7,6,5,7,6,
             7,6,8,5,7,7,7,7,7,6,8,6,8,7,7,6,7,8,7,6,6,8,
             8, 7,7,7,6,7,5,7,7,7,7,8,7,8,7,7,7)
)
```
